onboarding.title: Set up your restaurant workspace
onboarding.subtitle: Create a fictional restaurant for pre-launch testing. You become its owner; no payments are connected.
onboarding.invitedBody: Ask your manager to send an invitation to {{email}}. Existing workspaces are never opened to new accounts automatically.
onboarding.step1: Create your workspace — you become its owner.
onboarding.step2: Add stores and upload your logo to brand the app.
onboarding.step3: Invite managers and staff to the stores they work at.
onboarding.trialNote: Starts as a free trial with demo figures. No payment details needed.
onboarding.locationHint: Optional — you can add or rename stores later.
onboarding.saveFailed: Your progress could not be saved. Try again.

stages.title: Create your visual identity
stages.body: Upload a logo, adjust colors, and apply your theme.

stages.title: Preview your dashboard
stages.body: Review the demo figures and your restaurant’s appearance.

stages.title: Configure your stores
stages.body: Complete store details and manage locations within your plan allowance.

stages.title: Invite your team
stages.body: Create private invitations with the appropriate roles and store access. You can do this later.

stages.title: Open your workspace
stages.body: Your saved test restaurant is ready to explore. All performance figures remain demo data.

onboarding.teamLoadFailed: Couldn't check your team. Progress is unchanged; try again.

blocked.0: Save a logo or brand colors first.
blocked.2: Add an address and opening hours to at least one store first.
blocked.4: Finish branding and store setup first.

page.title: Team & access
page.subtitle: People who can access {{org}}. Tiers set the limits; profiles and adjustments set exactly what each person can do.
page.pendingHint: Invitation links are not emailed — share them yourself.
page.revokeBody: The link stops working immediately. You can invite them again later.
page.removeBody: They will immediately lose access to {{org}}. This is recorded in the activity log.
page.noAccessTitle: You don't have access to the team
page.noAccessBody: Ask an owner for the “Team · View” permission if you need to see who works here.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.subtitle: They get access only to this organization, and only to the stores you choose, after accepting with the same email.
invite.linkBody: Share this private link with {{email}}. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.notEmailed: No email was sent. Copy the link and share it with the person yourself. For security it can't be shown again after you leave this page.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
invite.noStores: You can invite staff only to stores assigned to you. Ask an owner to assign you a store first.

roleHelp.owner: Full control, billing, branding and ownership
roleHelp.manager: Runs assigned stores and manages staff in them

detail.ownerAccess: Owners have every permission in every store.
detail.isYou: This is you. You can't change your own access — ask another owner.
detail.readOnly: You can view this member's access but not change it.
detail.profileHint: Changing the tier or profile resets individual adjustments.
detail.noStoresHint: Without stores this person can sign in but won't see any store data.
detail.ownerAll: Owner tier includes every permission; the matrix is shown for reference.
detail.exceedsOwn: You can't grant permissions you don't have: {{list}}. Pick another profile or turn them off.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership to {{name}}?
transfer.body1: {{name}} becomes an owner of {{org}} with full control, including billing, branding and the team.
transfer.body2: You will become a manager. You keep only the stores already assigned to you and lose owner-only actions.
transfer.body3: Only an owner can undo this. The change is recorded in the activity log.

matrix.beyondOwn: You don't have this permission yourself

legend.inherited: Others come from the profile or tier default.

profiles.customSubtitle: Reusable permission sets for this organization.
profiles.ownerOnly: Only owners create or edit profiles.
profiles.systemSubtitle: Provided by Dinequora. Read-only — duplicate one to customize it.
profiles.editorHint: Permissions are capped to the tier. Members using this profile update when you save.
profiles.archiveInUse_one: Assigned to {{count}} member — move them first.
profiles.archiveInUse_other: Assigned to {{count}} members — move them first.
profiles.archiveBody: The profile disappears from the lists. Members can no longer be assigned to it.
profiles.emptyBody: Duplicate a template below or create a profile from scratch.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.tierHint: Tier sets the maximum this profile can include.
profiles.tierLocked_one: Assigned to {{count}} member, so the tier is locked.
profiles.tierLocked_other: Assigned to {{count}} members, so the tier is locked.
profiles.affects_one: Saving updates the access of {{count}} member.
profiles.affects_other: Saving updates the access of {{count}} members.

org_admin.name: Organization admin
org_admin.description: Everything except branding, billing and ownership.

manager.name: Store manager
manager.description: Runs assigned stores: sales, stock, purchases, team and reports.

cashier.name: Cashier / front of house
cashier.description: Sells at the POS and follows orders.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: Works the kitchen display and reads recipes.

stock.name: Stock keeper
stock.description: Keeps stock: items, counts, transfers, purchase orders and receiving.

finance.name: Finance
finance.description: Bills, expenses, payments and financial reports.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Who did what, where, and whether it was allowed. Refused attempts are recorded too.
activity.limitReached: Showing the latest 200 — narrow the filters to see older entries.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to make this change.
errors.permission_denied: Your access doesn't allow this action.
errors.permission_exceeds_own: You can't give someone permissions you don't have yourself.
errors.invalid_permission: One of the permissions isn't valid for this tier.
errors.invalid_profile: That permission profile is no longer available. Reload and try again.
errors.profile_tier_mismatch: The profile belongs to a different tier than the one selected.
errors.profile_tier_in_use: This profile is assigned to members of its current tier, so its tier can't change.
errors.profile_in_use: This profile is still assigned to members. Move them to another profile first.
errors.last_owner: An organization must always keep at least one owner.
errors.invalid_location: One of the selected stores doesn't belong to this organization.
errors.invalid_name: Use a name between 2 and 60 characters.
errors.not_member: This person is no longer a member of the organization.
errors.org_suspended: This organization is suspended, so changes are blocked.
errors.subscription_inactive: The subscription is inactive, so changes are blocked.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed — try again.

resetConfirm.title: Reset individual adjustments?
resetConfirm.body_one: Changing the tier or profile replaces {{name}}'s permissions with the new defaults. The {{count}} individual adjustment below will be discarded:
resetConfirm.body_other: Changing the tier or profile replaces {{name}}'s permissions with the new defaults. The {{count}} individual adjustments below will be discarded:
resetConfirm.note: Nothing is saved until you press “Save access”. You can re-apply adjustments afterwards in the matrix.

reissue.title: Issue a new invitation link for {{email}}?
reissue.body: A new link is created with the same tier, profile and stores, valid for 7 days. The previous link stops working.
reissue.note: Nothing is e-mailed: the new link is copied so you can send it yourself.
reissue.done: New invitation link created — use “Copy link” to share it.
reissue.doneCopied: New invitation link created and copied to the clipboard.
